feature: Claude MCP form/URL elicitation through native request broker
semantics: Explicit accept/decline/cancel through pending/respond; no automatic consent or URL navigation
Flat primitive form fields and string selection arrays; bounded JSON Schema validation without schema references or unknown answer fields
URL answers cannot carry form content
Attribution is explicitly session_request_during_active_execution because Claude supplies no tool-use identity on this envelope
Require replayed active input and exact runtime/execution/job/request identity; do not infer task completion from an answer
Withdrawn, cancelled and completed requests cannot be answered; CCB durable metadata/audit excludes form body and URL parameters

validation.initial_failure: New missing-echo test incorrectly expected completion after cancellation despite no input anchor. Updated to assert pending request retirement while terminal outcome remains unproven; runtime completion rule was not weakened.
validation.build: release build and bin hash equality passed

initial_real_probe.cause: --safe-mode disables even the explicitly supplied MCP fixture; no tools/call occurred
initial_real_probe.correction: Use a process-local disableAllHooks setting, strict fixture MCP config, no builtin tools and allow only the named fixture tool; preserve existing authentication. No permission-bypass flags.

limits: Real model validation covers one local form round trip, not every MCP server or URL authentication flow
Graphical forms, browser navigation, background/unowned request recovery and persistent permissions remain outside this change
Current active task attribution is routing context, not proof of which tool originated the session request
Provider history and caller answer files may retain data independently of CCB metadata
Harness cleanup reporting was hardened after the real run; no additional model request was made for that reporting-only change
No production/default installation change; Codex account-default test remains pending user decision
